title: It's Not Just You - The iOS Keyboard is Broken
summary: A short video arguing that the iPhone keyboard has gotten worse, showing slow-motion footage of taps registering the wrong letters. It claims the problem is iOS itself rather than user error.
why: Linked repeatedly as clear evidence of the iOS keyboard bug when people complain about typos.

quote.text: The YT video they linked is excessively clear about what the issue is.
